publication_policy: Official publication default is one run per model. Prior multi-run batches were exactly deterministic under the fixed prompt/dataset/temperature setup.
current_snapshot_policy: Dashboard exposes one current JSON. The current JSON is generated from one or more compatible batch/snapshot inputs; later compatible results replace earlier rows for the same model_id.
notes: Do not delete historical dist artifacts containing retired models; this roster controls future active publication only. Added deepseek-r1:8b as first manifest-append test model on 2026-05-10.
